# Message part catalogue — observed reality

**Status:** generated by reading clio-agent's emitters, not by editing `SPEC.md`
forward. Every row cites the source that constructs the part.

**Source of truth:** clio-agent `develop` @ `fbf7215e` (P2 complete).
**Supersedes:** the part-kind section of `SPEC.md`, which documents six kinds
and was last touched 2026-07-12 — before P0/P1/P2 landed.

---

## ⚠ The advertised contract version has NOT kept up

`clio_agent/gact/runtime/constants.py:27` still reads:

```python
CONTRACT_VERSION = "0.2"
```

Seven part kinds have been added to the wire since `SPEC.md` was written, and
the advertised version did not move. So:

- a client cannot use `contract_version` to decide whether these kinds are
  present — a `0.2` backend may or may not emit them depending on its build;
- this catalogue is therefore keyed to a **commit**, not a version.

Bumping to `0.3` is a coordinated change across clio-agent, clio-tui and
gact-tui and is **not** made here. Tracked in **clio-agent#1170**.

---

## Kinds emitted today

| kind | emitter | notes |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | assorted | plain assistant/user text |
| `thinking` | assorted | provider chain-of-thought; carries a token count |
| `tool_call` | assorted | `name` + `input` |
| `tool_result` | assorted | `content`, `is_error` |
| `expert_handoff` | assorted | child spawn — `expert`, `task_id`, `question` |
| `routing_decision` | assorted | selected expert |
| `mcp_app` | `mcp_apps` path | `ui://` MCP App payload |
| `file_diff` | assorted | `path`, `status` |
| `compaction` | assorted | context compaction marker |
| `background_exit` | `gact/background_exit.py:46` | **P2.14 / #1131** |
| `agent_message` | `gact/agent_messaging.py:116` | **P2.11 / #1128** |

`SPEC.md` documents only `text`, `thinking`, `tool_call`, `tool_result`, `ask`
and `compaction`.

## Run-handle fields

`background_exit` and `agent_message` both carry the group produced by
`run_handle_fields()` (`gact/agents/spawn_placement.py:98`):

| field | meaning |
|---|---|
| `handle_id` | stable run handle; falls back to `task_id` |
| `run_label` | display label, e.g. `data #1` |
| `live_state` | live state; falls back to task status |
| `host` | resolved host — `local`, or the host parsed from a relay placement |
| `placement` | placement grammar — `local` or `relay:<host>` |

Plus `agent_id`, `parent_agent`, `child_agent`.

`placement` is load-bearing for rendering: a run that exited on a remote host is
not the same event as one that exited locally, and the two must not be shown
identically.

### `background_exit`

Emitted **once** per terminal background task, downstream of the exactly-once
consumption gate. Additional fields: `task_id`, `job_id`, `exit_status`,
`artifact_ref` (only when the terminal fold supplied one), `status`.

`exit_status` ∈ `completed` | `failed` | **`canceled`** — one `l`, mapped from
the task status `cancelled` (two `l`s) at `background_exit.py:16`. The spelling
changes across that boundary; do not assume it round-trips.

### `agent_message`

Additional fields: `message_action` (`queue` | `steer` | `wake` | `supersede`),
`stage` (e.g. `message.queued`), `status`, `text`.

---

## Not emitted — do not build renderers

`a2ui`, `permission`, document and Live Web parts appear in the Session v3
prototype but no clio-agent code constructs them. They belong to P3. A renderer
for an unemitted kind cannot be tested against reality and is decoration.

The transcript's unknown-kind fallback (`part-unrenderable`) names any kind it
cannot render rather than dropping it, so their arrival will be visible.

---

## Verifying this document

```bash
# Every part type constructed by the backend:
grep -rhoE 'type="[a-z_]+"' src/clio_agent/gact/*.py src/clio_agent/gact/routes/*.py | sort -u
```

`compact_summary` and `system_message` also match that pattern but are **not**
parts — the first is a memory-event type (`routes/sessions.py:839`), the second
a command-result type (`routes/catalog.py:935`).
